scope: Native parallel brute-force candidate pairs with interaction groups, body/adjacency filters and bounded atomic append
tolerance_reason: Only computed AABB coordinates use f32 tolerance. Pair identities/counts, filters, padding, append prefix and untouched capacity remain exact. Atomic output order may differ.
preconditions: Finite unit poses and shape geometry; valid convex vertex ranges, including a readable first vertex for empty ranges
Positive batch count, native Rust-derived ABI and matching capacities, nonnegative finite prediction distance and positive length unit
Pair counter starts within capacity; finite ordered input bounds for pair-only operations; valid Rust interaction mode enum
invariants: All nine native shape branches and the unknown-tag default-origin AABB follow Rust
Batch-major scratch and interleaved shared collider state remain distinct
Interaction And mode wins when modes differ; same-body and shared nonzero adjacency tags filter pairs
Touching bounds intersect; prediction distance dilates one side only
Global atomic counter includes all eligible pairs even beyond storage capacity
Stored pairs are unique legal reservations; complete set when capacity fits, legal subset on overflow
Input buffers, padding and all inactive or unreserved output words are preserved exactly
outside_scope: Narrow-phase contact generation, shape support maps and queries
Changing-scene integration, production runtime selection and Ascend vendor compilation/execution
